documents.title: Credential rotation policy
documents.content: Credential rotation interval is 90 days. Rotate access credentials every 90 days and revoke compromised credentials immediately.

documents.title: Data retention policy
documents.content: Data retention period is 365 days for standard audit records. Delete expired records after 365 days unless a legal hold applies.

cases.answer: The credential rotation interval is 90 days.
The standard data retention period is 365 days.
